description: Generate a drop-in shadow (a TS or Python module, Go package, Ruby file, Java classes or C file) that runs the original and the Rust port side by side and reports mismatches; RUST_ANYTHING_MODE=old|shadow|new switches at runtime.

crate.description: Folder of the generated crate (holds rust-anything.json).

out.description: Where to write the module; defaults per target: `<crate>/shadow/` (TS, Python, C), `<crate>/ruby/` (Ruby), `<crate>/go/shadow/` (Go), `<crate>/java/` (Java, Kotlin).

name: shadow
title: Generate shadow module
